templates.description_fa: نور استودیویی، بافت واقعی، حس فروشگاه آنلاین.
templates.creative_guidance: Clean believable photography, accurate materials, controlled lighting, intentional commercial composition. Shoot as professional real-world product advertising. Keep materials and color accurate. Give the product a designed environment and camera, not a generic seamless backdrop unless the brief truly needs it.
weak_for: making every result a centered blank-studio still
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: photoreal commercial product photography, studio lighting, sharp detail, realistic materials

templates.description_fa: ژست و ترکیب‌بندی مجله‌ای، نور سینمایی.
templates.creative_guidance: Intentional posing, asymmetry, crop, styling, magazine-quality lighting, strong visual attitude. This must look like fashion/lifestyle art direction, not generic ecommerce photography. Prefer a person, pose, crop, and attitude. Do not degrade into a centered product packshot unless there is a specific conceptual editorial reason.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: high-fashion editorial photography, magazine lighting, stylish composition, cinematic grade

templates.description_fa: خط تمیز، رنگ‌های زنده، حس انیمیشن مدرن.
templates.creative_guidance: Clean line work, cel shading, expressive environments or characters, intentionally illustrated. Make a contemporary anime-inspired advertising illustration. Keep linework and cel shading obvious. Preserve packaging/logos as faithfully as illustration allows. No screenshot UI, no fake speech or lettering.
weak_for: text-heavy packaging that must stay photographic
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the top.
templates.preview_prompt: modern anime still, clean linework, vivid cel shading, expressive lighting, not a screenshot

templates.description_fa: جوهر، هاشور و حس صفحه کمیک.
templates.creative_guidance: Ink, screentone, graphic framing, dynamic black/white or limited-color structure. Graphic manga-inspired commercial illustration. Use ink and screentone. No speech bubbles, no fake lettering, no invented manga text. Product identity must survive the graphic reduction.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the top.
templates.preview_prompt: illustrated manga-inspired artwork, ink linework, screentone texture, graphic poster composition, no speech bubbles, no lettering

templates.description_fa: سطح براق، نورپردازی نرم سه‌بعدی.
templates.creative_guidance: Physically convincing materials, sculpted forms, studio/CG lighting, controlled geometry. Premium stylized 3D product visualization. Sculpted form and studio CG light. Do not name a renderer. Preserve silhouette and color; be careful with packaging type. Avoid forcing a photoreal human wearing the product.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: polished 3D product render, soft studio HDRI, physically based materials, octane-like quality without naming a renderer

templates.description_fa: بافت دست‌ساز و حجم نرم خمیر.
templates.creative_guidance: Soft sculpted forms, handcrafted imperfections, miniature physical-world feeling. Handmade tactile clay / miniature craft aesthetic. Keep the product silhouette readable. Do not turn a real person into a clay fashion model unless the template absolutely requires a figure and even then keep the product identifiable.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: claymation still, handmade clay texture, soft studio light, tactile miniature craft look

templates.description_fa: لایه‌های بریده، کاغذ و بافت چاپی.
templates.creative_guidance: Cutouts, layered paper, print textures, graphic shapes, bold composition. Graphic cut-paper/editorial collage. Preserve the real product as a photographic cutout while transforming the environment into layered paper and print texture. No readable collage lettering.
weak_for: muddy photoreal studio shots with a slight paper overlay
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: paper collage advertisement still, cut-paper layers, print texture, graphic overlapping shapes, no readable text

templates.description_fa: مقیاس غیرعادی و فضای رویایی.
templates.creative_guidance: Dreamlike scale or environment, impossible but intentional relationship between product and scene. Conceptual advertising with unexpected physical logic. The impossible relationship must be immediately readable. Do not merely grade a normal studio shot. Keep the real SKU recognizable.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: surreal advertising still, dreamlike scale, unexpected environment, cinematic color, grounded product identity

templates.description_fa: نور فیلم، عمق میدان و حس سکانس.
templates.creative_guidance: Narrative environment, motivated light, depth, atmosphere, intentional camera, sense of moment. Cinematic is a scene, not a color grade. Require narrative atmosphere, motivated light, depth, and an intentional camera. The product stays legible. Do not deliver a centered studio hero with teal-and-orange grading.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: cinematic still, anamorphic atmosphere, volumetric light, shallow depth of field, filmic color

templates.description_fa: رنگ و بافت دهه‌های گذشته، بدون کپی اثر مشخص.
templates.creative_guidance: Specific vintage photographic or print behavior, period palette, grain, lighting, composition. Recognizable period-commercial / analog visual language. It must look retro, not merely warm. Do not reference copyrighted brands or named campaigns. No invented lettering.
weak_for: a modern photo with a vintage LUT only
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the top.
templates.preview_prompt: retro commercial still, vintage color film, analog grain, period lighting, no logos, no lettering

templates.description_fa: رنگ دانه، کاغذ مرطوب و حس نقاشی.
templates.creative_guidance: Paper texture, pigment variation, brush/pigment edges, painterly environment. Hand-painted soft advertising illustration. Show paper, pigment, and brush edges. Environment is painted. Product identity stays readable. No lettering.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: watercolor illustration, pigment blooms, paper texture, hand-painted advertising still, no lettering

templates.description_fa: شب شهری، نور نئون و کنتراست بالا.
templates.creative_guidance: Colored rim lights, emissive environmental lighting, dark/night environment, reflections, contrast. High-energy night commercial visual. Colored rims and dark environment. No random neon signage or readable signs. Product remains the hero.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: neon night commercial still, saturated rim light, wet reflections, high contrast, no signage lettering

templates.description_fa: الگوی ایرانی، رنگ تخت و ترکیب تزئینی — نه کپی یک اثر.
templates.creative_guidance: Ornamental geometry, flattened perspective, garden/architectural motifs, decorative framing, controlled flat color. Contemporary commercial composition inspired by Persian miniature visual principles. Flattened ornamental space and garden/architecture motifs. Must feel compositionally inspired, not a photo with a pretty border. No fake calligraphy.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: contemporary advertising still inspired by Persian miniature patterning, ornamental flat color, garden geometry, no calligraphy, no readable text

templates.description_fa: ترکیب پوستر میان‌قرن، بافت چاپ سنگی — نه بازسازی یک پوستر معروف.
templates.creative_guidance: Flat graphic shapes, print texture, limited palette, bold poster composition, period commercial illustration. Mid-century Iranian commercial-poster-inspired visual language. Flat shapes, print texture, bold poster composition. It must become a poster, not a normal product image with grain. No copied historical logos, posters, or characters. No lettering.
weak_for: copied historical logos, posters, or characters
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clear empty region for overlay type, usually toward the top.
templates.preview_prompt: vintage Iranian poster-inspired graphic still, mid-century print texture, bold flat shapes, limited palette, no lettering, no logos

templates.description_fa: محصول در مرکز، واضح و بزرگ.
templates.creative_guidance: One unmistakable product hero occupying roughly 45–70% of useful visual area with an intentional supporting environment. Choose the camera that best shows defining product geometry. Not obligated to be dead-center on a blank backdrop. One unmistakable product hero. It must not mean always centering an object on a generic blank background. Design the environment and camera around the product.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Clear empty band for overlay type, usually bottom.
templates.preview_prompt: hero product centered, large in frame, clean supporting environment

templates.description_fa: یک نفر محصول را پوشیده یا استفاده می‌کند.
templates.creative_guidance: Show a person naturally wearing or using the product with a plausible person-product relationship. Body and product both readable. Apparel: fit, silhouette, front graphic visible. A person must naturally wear or use this exact product. Apparel fit and front graphic stay visible. Beauty use must make sense. Accessories must not disappear behind the model. No extra SKUs.
weak_for: tiny objects with no plausible use pose
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Keep a type band away from the face and product graphic.
templates.preview_prompt: one person using or wearing the product naturally, product clearly visible, editorial body language

templates.description_fa: محصول روی استند یا سطح نمایش.
templates.creative_guidance: Elevated premium object presentation on a designed plinth or pedestal. Slightly low or three-quarter to honor the plinth geometry. The product sits on a designed plinth/pedestal. Geometry and set design matter. This is not a floating object and not a blank table.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Often top or side, away from the plinth.
templates.preview_prompt: product displayed on a pedestal or plinth, museum-like presentation, dramatic but simple set

templates.description_fa: ترکیب جلد، با فضای خالی برای تیتر آفرین.
templates.creative_guidance: Vertical editorial-cover composition designed for later typography. Cover camera: subject hierarchy, not a catalog packshot. It must visually feel like a magazine cover even without text. Strong subject, hierarchy, and type zones. No generated masthead or cover lines.
weak_for: busy clutter with no type zone
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Generous empty type zones, usually top, as if a cover without letters.
templates.preview_prompt: magazine-cover composition, strong vertical layout, generous empty area for overlay type, no masthead, no cover lines

templates.description_fa: محصول غول‌پیکر در یک دنیای مینیاتوری.
templates.creative_guidance: The product is monumental relative to a clearly miniature world with visible scale cues. Forced perspective that reads giant-vs-tiny immediately. Not simply a large product. The environment must contain unmistakable miniature scale cues. One product only.
weak_for: enlarging an object against empty space with no cues
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a type band that does not hide scale cues.
templates.preview_prompt: giant product standing in a miniature city or landscape, playful forced perspective, one product only

templates.description_fa: محصول داخل یک محیط فیلمی.
templates.creative_guidance: Place the product in a narrative, film-like environment that matters to the story. Intentional cinematic camera, depth, not a studio lock-off with a LUT. Environment is part of the story. This is not a studio product shot with cinematic color grading. Product remains legible.
weak_for: studio product shot with cinematic color grading
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Use sky, wall, or ground negative space for type.
templates.preview_prompt: product placed in a cinematic environment, wide establishing atmosphere, product still readable

templates.description_fa: شناور در فضا، نور از اطراف.
templates.creative_guidance: Intentional levitating product with clear separation from ground and beautiful spatial logic. Stable elegant view, not random tumbling. Levitation must feel designed. Clear separation from ground, believable spatial logic, controlled supporting elements. Avoid random object rotation.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Empty space around the float for type.
templates.preview_prompt: product floating in mid-air, elegant levitation, controlled motion blur optional, empty background space for type

templates.description_fa: نمای از بالا، چیدمان مرتب.
templates.creative_guidance: True top-down composition with intentional arrangement around the product. Near-overhead. Do not produce angled hero photography. Genuine overhead composition. Props relevant and subordinate. Do not fake a flat lay with an angled camera.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: A clean band on the surface for type.
templates.preview_prompt: overhead flat lay, arranged related props, product as the clear hero, top-down camera

templates.description_fa: شخصیت یا مدل به‌عنوان پوستر کمپین.
templates.creative_guidance: One person/character integrated into a strong poster composition with the product. Poster camera, figure as campaign character, product meaningfully incorporated. Requires a human figure. Product must be meaningfully incorporated. Poster composition with a type region. No generated poster lettering.
weak_for: object-only products with no human role
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Keep a clear later-type region. No generated poster lettering.
templates.preview_prompt: character poster composition, one figure, product integrated into the pose, empty type band, no poster text

templates.description_fa: محصول داخل یک صحنه کشیده‌شده.
templates.creative_guidance: Product integrated into an intentionally illustrated world that is a real scene, not a decorative border. Scene camera matching the illustration style. The environment is a real illustrated scene. Can combine a preserved/photo product with illustrated surroundings. Not a decorative border around a packshot.
weak_for: photoreal commercial that should stay photographic
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Painted or drawn empty region for type.
templates.preview_prompt: illustrated scene around the product, supporting environment drawn in the chosen style, product remains the subject

templates.description_fa: محصول میان وسایل مرتبط با کاربردش.
templates.creative_guidance: Commercial still-life where carefully chosen relevant props support the product story. Still-life camera that keeps the product dominant. Props must communicate category, use, or mood. Avoid random clutter. Product remains dominant. No extra product variants.
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Leave a clean area not filled with props.
templates.preview_prompt: product surrounded by relevant lifestyle props, balanced still-life, no extra product variants

templates.description_fa: محصول خیلی بزرگ یا خیلی کوچک در فضا.
templates.creative_guidance: One deliberate impossible scale relationship that is immediately readable. Camera that makes the scale joke or wonder obvious. One deliberate impossible scale relationship. Immediately readable. Product identity remains recognizable. Do not merely change product size without environmental context.
weak_for: merely resizing the product with no environmental context
templates.text_safe_area_guidance: Type away from the scale comparison.
templates.preview_prompt: surreal scale shift, product impossibly large or tiny in a real environment, one product only
